note: Operation-state vocabulary and transitions every component must implement identically (CONFORMANCE.txt 5). 'display' is the minimum meaning a user must see; 'exit' is the reference process exit code; 'sendAllowed' says whether a (re)send of the SAME blob may follow; 'showSuccess' is always false except confirmed.

built.display: Proved; awaiting carrier fee approval (nothing sent, no fee)

broadcasting.rule: journaled BEFORE the network call; resume = lookup first

uncertain.rule: never shown as sent or failed; lookup on next reconcile; same blob only

published.rule: after 2 blocks without inclusion: lookup, then same blob

released.display: Cancelled before proving; nothing sent, no fee

rejected.display: Rejected: notes spent elsewhere; nothing sent, no fee

conflicted.display: Carrier conflicted (XMR input spent elsewhere); record kept; approve a new carrier

refused.display: Node refused the carrier; record kept; approve a new carrier

transitions: no reply, unknown to node after bounded attempts
double spend of the XMR input
unknown AND record fails local admission
block rolled back; same carrier re-sent for no new fee
rollback below the record: same carrier re-sent (no new fee) unless notes spent elsewhere -> rejected
invariants: exactly one carrier fee per completed operation
the only bytes ever sent for an operation are its signed carrier blob
a refusal or a conflict never auto-builds a new carrier
no state other than confirmed is displayed as success
a fresh installation from the phrase sees chain state only (no pending journal)
